properties.name: Chaweng Beach
properties.notes: Most popular beach on the island — long stretch of white sand, plenty of facilities, restaurants, and beach clubs.

properties.name: Maenam Beach
properties.notes: Long, calm beach on the north coast. Excellent for swimming, quieter than Chaweng with a relaxed village feel.

properties.name: Choeng Mon Beach
properties.notes: Quiet northeast bay with shallow, clear water. Ideal for families and those seeking a less touristy setting.

properties.name: Bophut Fisherman's Village
properties.notes: Historic fishing village with boutique cafés, seafood restaurants, and the famous Friday Night Walking Street market.

properties.name: Big Buddha Temple (Wat Phra Yai)
properties.notes: Koh Samui's most recognisable landmark — a 12-metre golden Buddha visible from across the north bay. Free entry, causeway walkable.

properties.name: Nathon Pier & Market
properties.notes: The island's administrative capital. Authentic local market with lower prices, ferry connections to the mainland, and minimal tourist crowds.

properties.name: Karma Two Palms Beach Club
properties.notes: Beachfront club at Karma Panalee resort. Infinity pool aligned with the Gulf of Thailand, wood-fired pizza oven, Thai restaurant, watersports, and live DJ events. Opened January 2025.
properties.price: À la carte dining; sun lounger hire available

properties.name: Lamai Village
properties.notes: Lamai is Samui's second-largest beach area — a laid-back mix of beach, Muay Thai gyms, local markets, forest spas, and great food. Open the dedicated Lamai map for the full curated guide.

properties.name: Secret Sunrise Beach
properties.notes: 🔒 Members only — quiet beach, no crowds, best sunrise spot on the island.

properties.name: Expat Rooftop Club
properties.notes: 🔒 Members only — private expat community meetup space with sunset views over Chaweng.
